---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why is it worth doing? A real user story helps:
"As a \_\_, I want \_\_, so that \_\_."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want. UI mockups, API sketches, or example
request/response payloads are all welcome.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is this one better?

## Out of Scope / Non-Goals

What should this explicitly **not** do? (Helps prevent scope creep.)

## Implementation Notes

Optional: rough effort estimate, affected modules, migration concerns, whether
you'd like to send a PR.

## Additional Context

Links, screenshots, related issues, prior art in other projects.
